related.title: 路由器封包轉送平面
related.why: 查表、下一跳與 MTU 分析相通
related.whyEn: Lookup, next hops and MTU analysis transfer
related.transfer: 查表、下一跳與 MTU 分析相通
related.transferEn: Lookup, next hops and MTU analysis transfer
related.difference: IPv6 無基底標頭 checksum 且鄰居機制不同
related.differenceEn: IPv6 has no base-header checksum and different discovery
practice: 由「位址長度」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「IPv6 無基底標頭 checksum 且鄰居機制不同」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From address length, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "IPv6 has no base-header checksum and different discovery", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

history.year: 公開技術脈絡 / Public technical context
history.title: 位址與範圍
history.text: 官方公開資料「IPv6 規格 RFC 8200」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「位址長度」及「位址範圍」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference IPv6 specification RFC 8200 supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with address length and address scopes before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.
